paper.title: Generalized Foundation Model for Lithium-Ion Battery State-of-Health Prediction with Distribution Metric Learning

indexing: One-based battery IDs corresponding to battery_<id> keys
split_unit: Complete battery/cell; cycles from one battery are never divided between train and test
protocol_note: Training-cell SOH labels were used for supervised target regression. Test-cell SOH labels were reserved for evaluation. Input curves from both training and test target cells were used without test labels in the MMD domain-alignment term.
figure_note: paper_figure_display_cell_ids is a best-effort retrospective reconstruction of the original battery_<id> keys shown as Battery 1-4 in figure order. The mapping was inferred from surviving historical task files, cycle counts, and plotting indices, was not preserved as a separate contemporaneous record, and may contain errors. It is only a possible display subset and does not redefine the held-out test set.
